comment: DEAD CONFIG (audit F1). This file's former inline ShapeValidationStore declaration duplicated solid-config.json's live wiring (the same pathConstraints + tboxPaths, byte-identical) and self-described as 'a reference'. The active wiring is solid-config.json's inline ShapeValidationStore + AdmissionFloor + its own PatchingStore override. Nothing in the live import chain (docker-compose loads /config/solid-config.json) imports this file's parent (shape-validation/shape-validation.json) — verified during R-T5. The duplicated ShapeValidationStore block was removed so the live config is the single source of truth. The PatchingStore override below is the legacy CSS-v5-style chain (no AdmissionFloor); it is retained only as a structural record of where shape-validation slotted before the v8 floor and is NOT loaded.

@graph.comment: Legacy (unloaded) PatchingStore override — the live equivalent, which wires the AdmissionFloor into the chain, lives in solid-config.json.
